profile.headline: Engineering Leader | Digital Platforms | Web, Mobile & Full-Stack Technology
profile.summary:
Engineering leader with 10+ years of experience building and evolving consumer-facing web and mobile products, internal operations platforms, and distributed systems. I lead technical direction, architecture, and cross-functional delivery across digital ecosystems, including Burger King and Wendy’s platforms.
My background spans frontend and platform modernization, API and third-party integrations, microservices, cloud infrastructure, and kiosk hardware/software integrations. I remain hands-on with TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, React Native, Python, and modern AI/LLM tooling, including RAG, vector search, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead technical direction across Burger King’s web and mobile platforms, shaping frontend architecture, API integration boundaries, platform modernization, and end-to-end delivery.
• Architected and delivered an internal operations platform that centralizes drive-thru activity, equipment and facilities operational data, and digital integration status for restaurant monitoring.
• Coordinate cross-company API and system integrations across the order-to-delivery journey, resolving interface dependencies between digital ordering, partner, and restaurant systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering Leadership · Microservices · Software Architecture · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
• Led technical delivery across a globally distributed Wendy’s team, aligning frontend engineering, design, QA, and implementation across locations.
• Defined and implemented modern frontend platform migrations for Wendy’s e-commerce website, improving responsive behavior, maintainability, and development workflows.
• Contributed to kiosk integrations with scanning and payment hardware, coordinating device interfaces and software–hardware dependencies to expand kiosk capabilities.
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering Leadership · Software Architecture · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Designed and built a real-time internal chat system for sellers and supervisors, improving communication, coordination, and issue resolution.
• Architected a microservices-based backend for internal tools, improving performance, scalability, and maintainability.
• Developed a mobile warehouse product-flow application supporting inventory visibility, product movement, and operational efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · Software Architecture · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the redesign and modularization of the company’s main mobile product, built with Ionic, improving application performance, maintainability, and development speed.

- Worked across both frontend and backend systems, optimizing APIs and services to support the mobile application and improve overall system responsiveness.

- Refactored parts of the architecture to reduce bottlenecks and enable a more scalable and modular platform for future feature development.

- Designed and developed an internal marketing campaign management platform that allowed the business team to create, manage, and distribute advertisements across all company products.

- Built tools that enabled centralized configuration and scheduling of campaigns, improving coordination between engineering and marketing while increasing operational efficiency.

company.name: Universidad Central "Marta Abreu"​ de Las Villas

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description:
- Developed custom automation tools using PHP and Python to streamline campus IT operations, including user account provisioning, system administration tasks, and network monitoring, reducing manual workload for the IT department.

- Designed and maintained backend systems to support automated account management and infrastructure monitoring, improving operational visibility and response times.

- Managed and maintained the infrastructure required to deploy and operate multiple virtual machines, supporting approximately 20 institutional websites built on WordPress and Drupal.

- Oversaw server configuration, updates, and performance monitoring, ensuring high availability and reliability of campus web services.

- Provided technical support for website deployments, troubleshooting platform issues, and coordinating with internal teams to maintain consistent uptime and security.

positions.title: Assistant Professor
positions.description:
Assistant Professor of  “Computer Networks”  in the Faculty of Electrical Engineering.

Delivered undergraduate courses in Computer Networks, covering core topics such as network architectures, TCP/IP protocols, routing, switching, and distributed systems. Designed lectures, practical labs, and assessments to help students understand both theoretical foundations and real-world networking applications. Mentored students on technical projects and provided guidance on modern networking technologies and best practices.

projects.title: Mailper
projects.description: Mailper is a tool to create disposable email addresses. Disposable email addressing sets up a different, unique email address for every sender/recipient combination. It operates most usefully in scenarios where someone may sell or release an email address to spam lists or to other unscrupulous entities.

projects.title: NetData App
projects.description:
NetData is a system for distributed real-time performance and health monitoring. It provides unparalleled insights, in real-time, of everything happening on the system it runs.
NetData App allow you to connect with your NetData instance and provide you a system monitoring tool designed to monitor as many services and system resources as possible.
